verdict.rationale: Jan's README lists both halves of the story: local LLMs downloaded from HuggingFace, and cloud integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, MiniMax and others. Its docs say users can "switch freely between local and frontier models" and "plug in your favorite online models," which matches mixing cloud and local models in one interface. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how cloud providers are configured (API keys, per-thread model switching), and independent or hands-on confirmation of the mixed workflow.
